name: list_spec
description: 以树形结构列出所有可用的规范文件。规范位于 agent/prompts/main/spec/ 下，可组织在子文件夹中。每个 spec id 是其相对路径（不含 .md 扩展名，如 "coding/typescript"）。先使用此工具发现可用规范，再用 get_spec 读取。
description_en: List all available spec files as a tree. Specs live under agent/prompts/main/spec/ and may be organized in subfolders. Each spec id is its relative path (without .md extension), e.g. "coding/typescript". Use this tool to discover available specs, then get_spec to read one.
